scope: User-authorised cron test in the already-open interactive conversation against the deployed local native backend.
summary: Live interactive cron fired in the enrolled conversation.

pause.controllerPolicy: Pause after first native admission, without interrupting that turn.

limitations: Explicit reservation, not arbitrary active-chat adoption.
No atomic protection against simultaneous human input.
CLI transport requires the conversation's existing shell permission.
No remote node, physical reboot or backend-disconnection certification.
